messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve"
set: ["it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve", "it may take up to 2 weeks before symptoms improve", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "your symptoms may not improve for up to several weeks", "symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks", "up to 2 to 3 weeks", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "cholesterol levels", "may take up to 8 weeks of using this medicine before ulcer heals", "blood cholesterol levels", "total cholesterol levels", "up to 5 weeks", "it may take 4 weeks or longer before you feel the full benefit", "may take several weeks before you notice a difference", "2 to 3 weeks", "up to 2 or 3 weeks for muscle spasm"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
